description: sfxnz's two-DGX-Spark vLLM TP2 kit (head 8087818b, 2026-10-30, no upstream release tag) for its EXL3 2.7 bpw mixed-K pack of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, branch 2.7bpw-mcg-hq (snapshot a8006e99, 405 GB on the Hub: routed experts as EXL3 MCG trellis with K in {2,3,4} per layer and projection group, lm_head in MXFP8, DSpark/MTP experts and the Engram tables from the same pack). It replaces our recipe for sfxnz's September 2.0 bpw pack of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash in place, as the kit states it replaces that recipe. Built on the digest-pinned vllm/vllm-openai:deepseekv41-flash-0909 arm64 image: upstream's docker/Dockerfile steps (the e16-rows image: Engram on disk, vllm-exl3 native MoE kernels, ExLlamaV3, tensor-core prefill MoE) and its whole docker/patch directory are baked byte-identically at the paths run.sh bind-mounts; its boot-time vLLM source rewrites are pre-applied at build because the Vonk root is read-only, and a build-time sm_121 scan covers the compiled extension modules. Upstream defaults: four sessions at a 500,000-token window from one 3.875 GiB fp8 KV pool with packed KV groups (the window can be raised to 1,048,576 for one request, which upstream measured on its release boot), DSpark with width 5 at 1-2 requests and 3 at 3-4 with adaptive verify, 8192-token prefill chunks, vision on, thinking off by default (clients can turn it on per request), tool calls and reasoning parsed by vLLM's deepseek_v41 parsers, xgrammar structured outputs. Not carried: upstream's API gateway container (a second container on the head that serves the DeepSeek API in front of vLLM; upstream's API_GATEWAY=0 mode, which this recipe uses, serves vLLM directly), its post-ready engagement audit and warmup (host-side run.sh steps), the unsafe-override switches and its SSH orchestration. Upstream claims (measured on its own two Sparks, not measured here): 51.3 tok/s greedy prose and 103.6 tok/s structured output at concurrency 1, 96.4 tok/s aggregate over four distinct prose sessions. Memory is an estimate: 97.73 GiB of weights per rank plus the 3.875 GiB KV pool and the 8 GB runtime overhead; upstream saw MemAvailable minima of 2 to 4 GiB per node, so the margin is thin. Licences are information only: kit scripts MIT (upstream LICENSE), DeepSeek weights MIT, the vllm-exl3 plugin the image builds is AGPL-3.0 per upstream. Vonk physical acceptance of this revision is pending.
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 EXL3 2.7 bpw sfxnz vLLM two Sparks
